batch_objective: B-114 data safety: a CSV import must never produce a map that cannot be re-opened. Two CSV rows whose ids slugify to the same id collapse into one node with two parents; the preview renders it, the commit saves it, and re-open fails (MapStoreError/ParseError, mapper/mermaid.py:85). Make the import and the save refuse or resolve what the loader refuses, so a saved map always re-opens.
